misprints.note: Dative, but printed with no iota subscript.
The article that ends the Dolk entry (κοπίς, ίδος, η.) is printed with no rough breathing.

uncertain.note: The stop before the colon is damaged and looks almost like a comma. I took it as the book's usual ".:".
The mark over υ is a combined curved glyph. It reads best as smooth breathing with an acute, but it could be a circumflex.
The final stop sits slightly raised, like a Greek ano teleia. I wrote a full stop, as elsewhere in the book.
